description_en: Queries the list of project authorizations
name: ListProjectAuthorizations

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID。
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The request token. Leave this parameter empty or set it to an empty string for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 请求 Token，首次请求不传或者传空字符串
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of project authorizations to return per request. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求获取最大项目授权个数，取值 1-100 整数。不传时默认取值 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The keyword for fuzzy search by project authorization name
parameters.help_zh: 按项目授权名称模糊查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to skip.
This parameter takes effect only when NextToken is empty
parameters.help_zh:
跳过数量。
仅在 NextToken 取值为空时生效
parameters.name: skip

MaxResults.description_en: The value passed in the MaxResults request parameter if a valid MaxResults parameter was specified. Otherwise, the default value is returned
MaxResults.description_zh: 请求参数中传了有效 MaxResults 时返回请求时所传的值，否则返回默认值

NextToken.description_en:
The token required for the next query when using cursor-based pagination.
Leave this parameter empty for the first query. For subsequent requests, set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned in the previous response
NextToken.description_zh:
游标查询下次查询所需的Token。
首次查询时留空，下次请求时传上次查询返回值中的NextToken字段值

Description.description_en: The remarks of the project authorization

ScopeType.description_en:
The scope of manageable assets associated with the authorization. Valid values:

1: All projects.

2: Specified projects
ScopeType.description_zh:
授权关联可管理的资产范围。取值：

1：所有项目。

2：指定项目

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of project authorizations returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的项目授权总数量
